challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Alex's repeated willingness to spend time alone with Jordan, including initiating twice, meaningfully supports possible special interest.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and including Jordan's preferred tea show individualized attentiveness, though the tea was among several options brought to a group meeting.

Three extended post-event conversations involving personal updates and future activities support sustained interest in connecting with Jordan, but their mixed group and personal content is not clearly romantic.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains the narrow primary interpretation, but with reduced confidence. HA-F1 through HA-F3 collectively provide meaningful evidence of special attention. However, HA-F4 shows that Alex is broadly warm and has also made one-on-one plans with another friend, while HA-F5 contains no explicit romantic framing or contact and HA-F6 shows only tentative follow-through. The record therefore supports general friendliness somewhat more than special or potentially romantic interest, but not decisively.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Continue assessing whether Alex follows through on future one-on-one plans or shows clearer differentiation between Jordan and other friends.
